oldToolReference.build: xcodebuild -project concourse.xcodeproj -scheme concourse -configuration Debug -destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 -derivedDataPath /tmp/vaporize-compare-old-concourse-derived SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES build

newToolInitialRun.command: vaporize build --artifact app --package-path private/apple/apps/concourse --product concourse --configuration debug --xcode-project private/apple/apps/concourse/concourse.xcodeproj --scheme concourse --xcode-destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 --derived-data-path /tmp/vaporize-compare-new-concourse-derived --xcode-build-setting SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES
newToolInitialRun.firstError: App bundle not found; checked /tmp/vaporize-compare-new-concourse-derived/Build/Products/Debug/concourse.app while XcodeGen built concourse-0.1.0-debug.app

compatibilityFix.behavior: When an app build uses an Xcode project or workspace and --app-bundle-name is omitted, Vaporize reads adjacent project.yml and resolves WRAPPER_NAME for the selected target/configuration.
compatibilityFix.boundary: This is compatibility lookup only. It does not make project.yml the forward source of truth for generation.

newToolRerun.command: vaporize build --artifact app --package-path private/apple/apps/concourse --product concourse --configuration debug --destination /tmp/vaporize-compare-new-auto-install --force --xcode-project private/apple/apps/concourse/concourse.xcodeproj --scheme concourse --xcode-destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 --derived-data-path /tmp/vaporize-compare-new-concourse-derived-auto --xcode-build-setting SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES

comparisonVerdict.observedDivergenceClosed: Vaporize now derives XcodeGen WRAPPER_NAME for legacy project.yml compatibility when app-bundle-name is omitted.
comparisonVerdict.remainingBoundary: This proves one old-tool/new-tool Concourse build comparison. It does not prove Pkl-backed project generation or fleet build parity.
